summary: Sandbach United secured a convincing 2-0 victory over Eccleshall in their recent FA Vase match, with Josh Fowles opening the scoring early on and Kyle Foley adding a second after the break. The Ramblers had to manage a period with ten men after Robbie Hatton's sin bin near the end of the first half, but held firm to claim all three points in what was described as a tight contest.
